name: auriga
description: Auriga — Pantheon auto-router. Root test entrypoint so CI's generic Node gate (ci.yml) actually runs the router's unit + loop-level e2e suite.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src/router src/server && npm run lint --prefix src/ui
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm test --prefix src/server && npm run build --prefix src/ui && npm run test:e2e --prefix src/ui && npm run test:e2e:hardening --prefix src/ui
